description: Source code for a sample application demonstrating the use of the GL_OVR_multiview2 extension, including setup of multiview rendering, shader programs, and rendering a scene with two cubes and a final compositing step.

classes.name: MultiviewSample
classes.description: A class inheriting from SampleApplication that sets up and renders a multiview scene using the GL_OVR_multiview2 extension, including scene initialization, rendering, and cleanup.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the application, checks for extension support, creates textures, framebuffers, shader programs, and scene geometry.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up allocated OpenGL resources such as shaders, textures, buffers, and framebuffers.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering: first to the multiview framebuffer with two cubes, then composites the views into the final display.
